name: webuildco-site
description: WeBuild Co marketing site — Awesomic-style, token-driven, static Tailwind v4 build

scripts.guard:branch: [ -z "$WORKERS_CI" ] || [ "$WORKERS_CI_BRANCH" = main ] || { echo "WEB-515 guard: branch '$WORKERS_CI_BRANCH' is not main - refusing to build, so no deploy runs." >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.build: npm run guard:branch && npm run build:css
